scope: Interpretation of the running larger panel; query selection, searches and thresholds unchanged.
limits: The232pair protein-detection panel is not a nested enlargement of the24pair upstream-screen panel. Their per-query timings describe different input mixtures and lengths, not a controlled asymptotic scaling law.
The separate validation_n_sample experiment addresses query-count scaling on nested inputs.
One protein-only pair per sample cannot establish three-exemplar species calls or a production end-to-end detection gain.
Original8thread nucleotide wall times include shared-worker contention; new16thread controls are the timing comparators for the translated arm.
NR retains its original protein-reference and eligibility filters; cross-reference disagreements are measured evidence, not known-truth sensitivity or specificity.
